step1_analysis.description: The circuit is a cascode differential amplifier (XM3-XM7) commonly used as a Low Noise Amplifier (LNA), IF amplifier, or mixer transconductance stage in RF transceivers to provide high gain and reverse isolation. A secondary differential pair (XM1-XM2) is also present, which may act as a local oscillator (LO) buffer or part of a switching quad.

power_consumption.description: Total DC power consumption of the amplifier stage.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Based on VBIAS=0.7V and W/L=10 for the tail current source in SKY130.

sky130_expected.calculation: gm = 547uS, Rload = 10k. Gain = gm * Rload = 5.47 V/V = 14.7 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Depends heavily on the chosen load resistor and bias current.

sky130_expected.calculation: BW = 1 / (2 * pi * Rload * C_parasitic). Assuming C_parasitic ~ 10fF, BW ~ 1.6 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Limited by the RC time constant at the output nodes.

phase_noise.description: Phase noise of the oscillator at 3-MHz offset.

sky130_expected.reasoning: System-level metric reported in the paper, depends on LC tank Q-factor.
Typical IIP3 for a CMOS receiver front-end.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure DC power, AC voltage gain, bandwidth, and transient output swing of the cascode differential amplifier.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Cascode Differential Amplifier Testbench
.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N3 N10 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N11 N6 N7 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N5 INN N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 BIAS GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N4 INP N0 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N2 N9 N4 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N8 N9 N5 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}

* Biasing and Supplies
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
VBIAS BIAS 0 0.7
VCASC N9 0 1.5

* RF Inputs (DC biased to keep tail in saturation)
VINP INP 0 DC 1.2 AC 0.5 SIN(1.2 0.01 2.4G 0 0)
VINN INN 0 DC 1.2 AC -0.5 SIN(1.2 0.01 2.4G 0 0)

* Loads for Cascode Stage
R1 VDD N2 10k
R2 VDD N8 10k

* Biasing and Loads for Secondary Pair
I2 N7 0 100u
V10 N10 0 1.2
V6 N6 0 1.2
R3 VDD N3 10k
R4 VDD N11 10k

* Differential Output Extraction
E1 out_diff 0 N8 N2 1.0

.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.control
* DC Operating Point
op
let power = -i(VVDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1M 10G
let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
meas ac max_gain max gain_db
let gain_3db = max_gain - 3
meas ac bw when gain_db=gain_3db fall=1

* Transient Analysis for Output Swing
tran 10p 5n
meas tran vout_pp pp v(out_diff)

quit
.endc
